name: AWS Elastic Load Balancer - Application
description: The Sumo Logic AWS Elastic Load Balancer (ELB) - Application App lets you search logs in your S3 bucket, giving you visibility into the health of your Application Load Balancer and Target Groups. You can analyze raw Application Load Balancer data for the availability of applications running behind Application Load Balancers or correlate Application Load Balancing data with other data sets to understand the fault tolerance of your applications across multiple AWS Availability Zones.
